title: pelargonium angulosum
intro: Pelargonium angulosum, commonly known as the Rough-leaved Geranium, is a species of succulent plant in the family Geraniaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Pelargonium angulosum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
